summary: No public dataset co-registers intracellular fibrils with whole-cell shape for decapod sperm or ciliates: EMPIAR has no decapod sperm or ciliate-cortex volumes (only mouse sperm flagella cryo-ET and Tetrahymena single-particle sets), the BioImage Archive's only protist morphology set is external SEM of Tara Oceans plankton (S-BIAD598, 1,075 files, CC BY 4.0), and the Cell Image Library offers uncounted 2D micrographs. The fibril-removal perturbation and the Plateau reference figure would have to be produced by new experiments; the comparative ultrastructure is in individual papers, not repositories.
next_step: Compile from the literature a table of ciliate/decapod-sperm shape vs. documented fibril systems (myonemes, kinetodesmal fibres, sperm arms/spikes) as a first qualitative test; for a quantitative test deposit volume-EM of a spiral decapod sperm with and without fibril disruption.
obstacles_confirmed: Cortex and sperm ultrastructure are spread across individual papers, with quantitative shape-versus-fibril tables for only a few model ciliates.
Sparse taxonomic coverage limits the broad generalization (no decapod or ciliate whole-cell volumes in EMPIAR).
